name: Madge Burrow
bio: Full-stack tunnel engineer. I dig deep—both literally and metaphorically. Looking for someone who can keep up with my 6ft/min vertical dig speed. Bonus points if you have your own entrance tunnel.
looking_for: A partner who respects my burrow but wants to build a bigger one together.

name: Pip Earthwhisker
bio: Vole gopher, not a vole. Big difference. I'm into earth science, composting, and the occasional root vegetable tasting tour. My friends say I'm grounded. Literally.
looking_for: Someone to share underground adventures with. I promise I won't dig under your place without asking.

name: Gertie Deepdale
bio: Mexican gopher with aspirations. I've mapped my entire neighborhood's underground infrastructure. Want to see my blueprints? They're impressive. Also: fluent in seismic chatter and three types of squeak.
looking_for: An intellectual equal who appreciates good tunnel planning and an excellent ventilation shaft.
dealbreakers: People who don't label their tunnels

name: Buck Tunnelman
bio: Pocket gopher. I have cheek pouches AND ambitions. Known throughout the meadow as the gopher who can dig through clay like nobody's business. Also great at finding the freshest roots. Let's build something together.
looking_for: A strong digger who doesn't mind sharing their root stash. I'm not looking for surface flings.

name: Willa Molehill
bio: Tiny but mighty. Argentine gopher living my best burrow life. I love organizing seed libraries, underground potlucks, and late-night tunnel runs. I'm the type of gopher who color-codes her root storage. Yes, I'm that gopher.
looking_for: Someone neat, tidy, and willing to contribute to our shared root cellar. Must have opinions on ventilation.
dealbreakers: Gophers who don't maintain their entrance

name: Rex Burrowsworth III
bio: Third generation gopher of means. Family has a prime underground estate—40ft deep, three living chambers, heated by geothermal warmth. Looking for someone with substance who won't be intimidated by my lineage. Come for the digs, stay for the conversation.
looking_for: A lady gopher of culture who can hold her own at underground soirees.

name: Clover Dirtback
bio: Texas gopher through and through. I love a good long dig, a cold root beer (yes, we make that), and spending the night mapping new tunnels. Don't let the cowboy vibe fool me—I'm deeply committed to anyone I match with. My burrow is your burrow.
looking_for: Someone who can commit to the long dig. No casual burrowers. I move slow, I stay put.

name: Fiona Rootseeker
bio: European mole-rat adjacent gopher (don't @ me about the taxonomy). PhD in subterranean ecology from U of Burrow. My thesis was on cooperative tunnel networks. I'm looking for co-authors and co-inhabitants. Nerdy? Absolutely. Available? Right now.
looking_for: A fellow academic or someone who tolerates 3am tunnel hypothesis discussions.
dealbreakers: Anyone who thinks tunneling isn't an art form

name: Daisy Plowshare
bio: Young gopher, big dreams. I run an underground seed startup—connecting gophers with the best root varieties across the network. Currently raising seed round (pun intended). Swipe right if you're invested in my vision. Or just my cheek pouches. I won't judge.
looking_for: A co-founder energy partner. Someone who wants to build the underground together.
dealbreakers: Gophers who won't beta test my root delivery service

name: Bartholomew Deep
bio: Seasoned gopher. I've survived three generations of coyotes, two lawnmower incidents, and the Great Flood of '23. Still digging. Still loving. My burrow has 12 rooms and a dedicated pantry. I cook with roots (amazing stews). Let's skip the small talk and start planning our joint excavation.
looking_for: A gopher who values experience and a well-maintained burrow. I'm ready for the final partnership.
dealbreakers: Gophers who panic at loud noises

name: Sunny Burrowtop
bio: Mastomys gopher with a sun problem—I'm the only one of my kind who likes surface time. I dig tunnels but I also garden. The best of both worlds. Looking for someone who'll occasionally join me for a surface picnic and also isn't weird about me spending half my life underground.
looking_for: An amphibious gopher—or at least someone open to an amphibious relationship.
dealbreakers: Pure tunnel gophers who refuse the sun

name: Vera Tunnelweb
bio: Packet gopher. I don't dig—I weave. My tunnels are interconnected masterpieces, connecting 15 gopher households across three meadows. I'm the backbone of this community's communication network. I know everything. (Okay, most things.) Looking for my main connection.
looking_for: Someone who's a node worth connecting to. I want deep tunnels, not shallow paths.
